title: Legacy workspace data migration
scope: Move launch configurations, checkpoint history and command logs from workspace .janusX folders to the JanusX application data location below.
cleanup: Verified legacy files are removed after migration succeeds. Project source, unrecognized files and Hook assets stay in place. The .janusX directory is removed only when empty.
retention: Time-based retention restarts once at the first successful migration. Original creation dates are preserved. Retries and later ordinary upgrades do not restart it again.
closeTasks: Close terminals and running tasks in the selected workspaces and their subdirectories, and exit older JanusX versions still using these folders before migrating.
noPending: No workspaces awaiting migration. Reconnect offline workspaces or resolve errors, then check again.

status.cleanup-pending: Using new storage; legacy cleanup incomplete
status.unsupported: Migration required in the workspace environment
